panels.title: Events applied
panels.description: Managed events durably applied in the selected range.

targets.query:
WITH chosen(resolution) AS (
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN $__from >= (unixepoch('now') * 1000 - 604800000) THEN 60
    WHEN $__from >= (unixepoch('now') * 1000 - 2592000000) THEN 600
    WHEN $__from >= (unixepoch('now') * 1000 - 7776000000) THEN 3600
    ELSE 86400
  END
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(event_count_sum),0) AS value FROM event_telemetry_rollup, chosen
WHERE resolution_seconds=chosen.resolution AND bucket_start_ms >= $__from AND bucket_start_ms < $__to AND metric='event_apply' AND outcome='applied'

panels.title: SSE session duration
panels.description: Duration of completed SSE sessions. Frequent short sessions indicate connection instability.

targets.query:
WITH chosen(resolution) AS (
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN $__from >= (unixepoch('now') * 1000 - 604800000) THEN 60
    WHEN $__from >= (unixepoch('now') * 1000 - 2592000000) THEN 600
    WHEN $__from >= (unixepoch('now') * 1000 - 7776000000) THEN 3600
    ELSE 86400
  END
)
SELECT (bucket_start_ms/1000) AS time,
 CASE WHEN SUM(duration_count)=0 THEN 0 ELSE 1.0*SUM(duration_sum_ms)/SUM(duration_count)/1000 END AS 'average session',
 MAX(duration_max_ms)/1000.0 AS 'longest session'
FROM event_telemetry_rollup, chosen
WHERE resolution_seconds=chosen.resolution AND bucket_start_ms >= $__from AND bucket_start_ms < $__to AND metric='sse_disconnect'
GROUP BY bucket_start_ms ORDER BY bucket_start_ms

panels.title: Workflow execution duration
panels.description: Average/max executor invocation duration and failures by workflow kind.

targets.query:
WITH chosen(resolution) AS (
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN $__from >= (unixepoch('now') * 1000 - 604800000) THEN 60

FROM event_telemetry_sample
WHERE observed_at_ms >= $__from AND observed_at_ms < $__to AND (outcome IN ('failed','stream_error','apply_error','bound_hit') OR metric='sse_disconnect')
ORDER BY observed_at_ms DESC LIMIT 200
